english.description: Where's your face, dingus? Get your butt to the avatar creator and sort yourself out! Crying shame we can't fix that attitude of yours while we're at it.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_1

english.description: Ah, yes. Welcome to the Battle Hub. I do not know what you seek, but please, enjoy yourself. That is the purpose for which it was built, after all.
english.displayName: So This Is the Battle Hub...
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_2

english.description: Start by fighting a match in the Battle Hub. It doesn't matter if you win or lose. What matters is challenging yourself to take that first step.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_3

english.description: How's 30 matches in the Battle Hub sound? If yer not there yet, just keep at it! If ya wanna get sumo strong, ya can't be shy of the ring!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_4

english.description: Starting to get used to competition? Then set your sights on winning 30 Battle Hub matches. Gotta give yourself a challenge if you want to get anywhere in life.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_5

english.description: Ever hear of Extreme Battles? They're a little different from regular fights—a little more WILD. Try it out, and let your instincts take over!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_6

english.description: If you can't adapt, you won't last five seconds on the battlefield. Fight 20 Extreme Battles. Perfect training to sharpen your judgement.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_7

english.description: 20 wins in Extreme Battle. Should be a snap for someone like you, yeah? Stomp this one flat, then aim for even greater heights! Bwahaha!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_8

english.description: In Avatar Battles, you can battle others as an avatar―a self outside of your self. Go there, and experience all that such combat has to offer.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_9

english.description: Nothing gets my engine revving more than a brawl between avatars, live and in the flesh! Let's see you do 20 Avatar Battles!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_10

english.description: An alternate form of combat, with an alternate path to victory. Get 20 wins in Avatar Battles. But don't obsess over the results. Let experience be your guide.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_11

english.description: If you wanna match the one-and-only Jamie Siu, you'd better be early to the starting line. Give a Tournament a shot!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_12

english.description: The determination to stand in the ring and fight is what turns mind and muscle into tempered steel! Enter five Tournaments, and see for yourself!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_13

english.description: Ninja can leap staircases in a single bound, but there's no skipping steps in training. Win 10 matches in a Tournament. It won't be easy, but you can do it.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_14

english.description: Kung fu is the result of ceaseless training. Do anything enough times, and you'll see results. So will you, once you fight in the Battle Hub 100 times.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_15

english.description: Did you know you can play classic games at the Battle Hub Game Center? It's true! Cassette tapes and cartridges might be old...but they're still hecka rad.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_16

english.description: Ever try the Ranking Challenge at the Game Center? Give it a shot! It's important to always challenge yourself, even when it comes to games.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_17

english.description: Having an audience changes everything...and turns a mere fight into thrilling spectacle. Spectate a Battle Hub Match, and bear witness to glory.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_18

english.description: In combat, you must constantly analyze the situation. Spectate an Extreme Battle, and hone your ability to read and react to the unexpected.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_19

english.description: Ah, there's nothing quite like a fight, one-on-one, in the flesh! If you wanna appreciate it too, go spectate an Avatar Battle!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_20

english.description: Sounds like the Battle Hub has clubs you can join. Just like a sumo stable! You should join one! Ooh, I wonder if they have chanko stew...
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_21

english.description: Hrrah! To fight before a cheering crowd is an honor shared by all wrestlers! Go on—try earning yourself a "Nice" fan of your own!
english.displayName: Let the Praise Become Your Muscle
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_22

english.description: Uwo! My dream's to become famous, and make Mama proud! You should become famous too! Try sending or receiving 200 "Nice!" marks, for starters!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_23

english.description: Having outside support is a bit like having a spirit. You can't see them, but they lend you strength all the same. Send or receive 600 "Nice!" marks, and you'll feel strong too.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_24

english.description: I used to ask millions of questions as an agent. There's a lot you can learn from people just by talking to them—try chatting in the Battle Hub.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_25

english.description: Reviewing replay footage is a great way to learn from past fights. Watch with a calm, subjective eye, and you're bound to make some discoveries.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_26

english.description: Earned any titles for your efforts yet? Me? Pfft. I don't need a title. I'm Jamie freakin' Siu!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_27

english.description: A lone wolf is strong, but they're far more fearsome if they have a pack to call their own. So go on—try making some friends!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_28

english.description: Clothing allows us to express ourselves. Know who else never changes their clothes? Animals. Change your outfit. Please.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_29

english.description: Have you had a chance to jam out at the DJ Booth in the Battle Hub, bud? Pick your favorite tunes, and light the dance floor aflame!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_30

english.description: Sit down by the big monitor in the Battle Hub, and you can view all kinds of stuff. Man... Used to be me up there going wild on the big screen.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_31

english.description: You gotta help people in need. I mean, that's the secret to keeping any city peaceful. So get out there and complete 22 sub-missions, got it?
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_32

english.description: Once you find someone to call a master, you would do well to seek to deepen your bonds. Raise the bond with one of your masters to 100.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_33

english.description: I've worked a few odd jobs during my travels, and they all helped me with my training. You should take up a part-time job during your World Tour, as well.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_36

english.description: Something in the way while you're walking through the city? Here's an easy solution: send it flyin' with a Master Action! Mm-mm-mmm... It's the little pleasures in life.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_37

english.description: Fight 100 online battles via Fighting Ground. What's that? Too difficult, you say? If you wish to take on the world, there can be no other path.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_38

english.description: Gonna need ya to head to the Fighting Ground and finish Arcade Mode once, buddy! It's time ya heard the stories of your fellow fighters!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_39

english.description: You've heard of combo trials, I presume? It's time you practice attack sequences. I want you to finish 45 of them. It will be difficult, but I've the utmost faith in you.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_40

english.description: You know how a swallow can fly at speeds of up to 200 kilometers an hour? Well, even they were chicks once. It's all about practice! Get yourself to Training Mode!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_41

english.description: Whoa, you seen these Character Guide things? Talk about rad! They've got all kinds of info about people's fighting styles and moves. Oh yeah, Bushinryu gets some rep too, naturally.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_42

english.description: You want to learn street fighting fundamentals? Well, too bad, 'cause I'm not in the mood to take on any students. Go hit the Tutorials, kid.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_43

schinese.description: 你这家伙怎么回事……没脸见人吗？去“创建虚拟形象”再来吧。让我看看你能不能长点脸！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_1

schinese.description: 欢迎来到“格斗中心”。不管你的目的是什么，尽情享受吧。因为这里就是享乐之处。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_2

schinese.description: 先尝试一次“格斗中心对战”吧。输赢无所谓，重要的是勇于挑战。踏出这一步吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_3

schinese.description: 怎么样？打够30场“格斗中心对战”了吗？如果还没有，那就再接再厉！实力就是指登上相扑土台的次数！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_4

schinese.description: 你习惯对战了吗？下一个目标就是赢得30场“格斗中心对战”。如果不去挑战，一切都是纸上谈兵。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_5

schinese.description: 你知道“极限对抗”吗？那种格斗和一般的可不一样，你会大吃一惊哦。去试一次吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_6

schinese.description: 如果不能随机应变，在战场上将寸步难行。你去打20场“极限对抗”。这是在训练你的判断力。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_7

schinese.description: 赢20场“极限对抗”，对你来说不难吧？你快去做完，再树立更高的目标吧，哈哈哈！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_8

schinese.description: 你知道“虚拟形象对战”吧？就是用你的分身——虚拟形象和别人切磋。去吧，用你的分身去体验一下格斗吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_9

schinese.description: 用虚拟形象切磋，拳拳到肉，爽到发麻嘛。去打20场“虚拟形象对战”吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_10

schinese.description: 格斗的形式不同，胜利的形式自然也不同。争取赢20场“虚拟形象对战”吧。不过你不必太在意输赢，所有经验都会转化成你的实力。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_11

schinese.description: 如果你想像杰米哥我一样，以格斗界巅峰为目标，就先去报名吧。试试“赛事”！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_12

schinese.description: 站在擂台上，拥有不断格斗的决心才能磨练出坚强的心灵和肉体！你去参加5场“赛事”吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_13

schinese.description: 轻轻一跳就越过几级台阶的是忍术，修行可没这么容易越级。你去参加“赛事”，赢上10场。踏踏实实地努力吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_14

schinese.description: 勤学苦练才能出真功夫，量变必将带来质变。去挑战吧，在格斗中心“对战”100场。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_15

schinese.description: 你知道吗？在格斗中心的“街游中心”里可以玩经典游戏！不仅是磁带，这种有年代感的东西我都喜欢。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_16

schinese.description: 街游中心不是有“排位榜挑战”吗？别以为那些只是游戏，去试试吧。最重要的是凡事敢挑战，对吧？
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_17

schinese.description: 正因为有观众动作才会变化，格斗才会精彩。去试试“格斗中心对战”的“观战”吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_18

schinese.description: 格斗总是需要分析情势。去“观战”“极限对抗”吧。可以训练你对格斗手和障碍物的预判能力。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_19

schinese.description: 啊——拳脚相向的格斗果然很棒啊！你也去“观战”“虚拟形象对战”吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_20

schinese.description: 据说格斗中心有“俱乐部”这种东西。和相扑部屋差不多！你也加入一个“俱乐部”吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_21

schinese.description: 哼！在助威声中格斗，对摔跤手来说是很光荣的！你也去热斗一场，获得大家的助威吧！“喝彩”就是助威的证明，你要得到它哟！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_22

schinese.description: 唔哦，我的梦想就是走红，让妈妈开心！你也要走红哦！去获得助威，积攒200次“喝彩”吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_23

schinese.description: 助威和精灵很像啊。虽然看不到，但却会给你带来力量。你也去获得助威……积攒600次“喝彩”吧，让它成为你的力量。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_24

schinese.description: 作为刑警，我也经常打探案情……与人交谈会让你受益匪浅。在格斗中心使用“聊天频道”吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_25

schinese.description: 用“回放”功能回顾别人的格斗吧。客观冷静地观看别人的格斗，你肯定能有所感悟。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_26

schinese.description: 你有没有大显身手，获得过一个“称号”啊？嗯？我？我杰米 · 肖的大名本身就是个称号，不是吗？哈哈哈！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_27

schinese.description: 独行并不等于强大哦。狼无论独行，还是成群都很强大。我觉得交“朋友”也很不错。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_28

schinese.description: 不同的服饰可以展现不同的自我。如果不分时间场合总是同一副打扮，那和动物有什么区别？快在设备里“变更”“装备”吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_29

schinese.description: Yeaaah！格斗中心里有“DJ台”哦！你在那里打过碟吗？用你喜欢的music让大家舞起来吧！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_30

schinese.description: 在格斗中心的“大屏幕”前，还有椅子供人坐着“观看”。我自然是负责在屏幕中亮相，华丽出演啊……
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_31

schinese.description: 在别人需要帮助的时候，你就要尽量去帮助。这就是维持城市和平的秘诀。你去完成22个“支线任务”吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_32

schinese.description: 一朝踏入师门，就应加深师徒交情。去把“师徒交情”提升到100吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_33

schinese.description: 我也在修行的途中打过不少工。无论什么工作都会对你的修行有帮助。在环球游历时，你也去“打工”吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_36

schinese.description: 你走在街上的时候，不是会有人来找麻烦吗？那种人就该用“师父动作”狠狠地教训一顿！你试试吧，感觉很不错的。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_37

schinese.description: 在斗技战场进行100场“线上赛”。很难做到吗？但这是走向世界的必经之路。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_38

schinese.description: baby！去通关斗技战场的一个“街机”游戏吧。这样你就能听到了吧？格斗手们的story！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_39

schinese.description: 你知道“连招锻炼”吧？就是练习打连招。你去完成45项吧。虽然很不容易，但对你很有好处，我相信你能行。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_40

schinese.description: 你知道吗？空中时速200公里的燕子……也是从一只雏鸟练出来的。你也要在“训练模式”中多多练习。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_41

schinese.description: 哦！“角色指南”真是好东西啊！会教你格斗手们的招式和格斗方式。你去看看怎么样？啊，也会教你武神流哦。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_42

schinese.description: 想了解街头格斗的基础？不好意思，我现在没心思收徒……你去“教学”看看吧。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_43
